standard-dialogue-lletya.npc: Huh... Oh sorry, you made me jump. I was miles away, day dreaming.
I was thinking about the crystal spires of Prifddinas.

standard-dialogue-lletya.player: It must be beautiful, I've only seen the city walls.

steps.npc: I have never seen it, all I know are the stories. I hope that changes one day.
I have never seen it, all I know are the stories. I hope that once this war is over, I'll finally be able to.

standard-dialogue-prifddinas.player: Hey there. How is it being the new Lady Ithell?

standard-dialogue-prifddinas.npc: It's a daunting job, but I have the knowledge of my predecessor to help me.
It's still crazy how fast it all happened. One moment I was a daydreaming elf, who'd never even seen Prifddinas. Now I'm responsible for an entire elf clan.

standard-dialogue-prifddinas.player: Well don't worry, I'm sure you're doing great.

overhead-dialogue-failed-pickpocket-atte.npc: What do you think you're doing?
